_about: 4-31 (R1 fix 1; re-authored in step 133): the key and button_2110 lie inside antiportal_2085 (scale
3, 96 px at 32 x scale), behind door_lift_2111, which only that button raises; every portal here is
98.5 px or more from the ring's centre (the launch exit at (252, 40) is the nearest). Right off the
anchor to the lower floor; a shot lights the torch (tick 106) and the light wall goes (196). On
button_2105 door_lift_2104 rises; a portal through it at (200, 150) and one on the player: into the
lower middle. A portal on the left ledge at (150, 20) and one on the player. A portal at (252, 40)
and one at (192, 98) below the ledge's edge: right off the edge, into the low portal and out of the
high one moving up and right, over the gap where the light wall stood, onto the upper platform.
STEP 133: door_lift_2104 now latches as the original's does. The player's few ticks on button_2105
raise it all the way (6000 ms, to tick 578), and it falls only from there, so on tick 600 its top
still stands above the upper platform at x 337-367 and stops the player at x 327.3. The player
waits there until the falling door's top is below its feet (tick 770), then walks right over it to
the key (785); everything after is the old route 170 ticks later. Left off the platform down the gap
to the floor; a portal on the block beside the keyhole at (288, 168) and one on the player; right
into the shaft: the key opens the keyhole and the yellow door goes. A portal at (250, 120) and one
on the player out of the shaft; left into the door. Won on tick 1167. Leans on G10 (air control) and
G4 (shot speed); the knight never moves from its post.
